document_strings: Sir JE FFFREY transfered me TO BEEKMAN DOWNSTATE INA PRIVATE AMBULANCE - AFTER COMING HOME FROM BEEKMAN DOWNSTATE.
I AM STILL WORKING for MARK
STAYED AT THE PLAZA MOTEL IN TEL-AVIV
STAYED IN J. FOR ABOUT 4 DAYS

handwriting_candidates.text_as_seen: Sir JE FFFREY transfered me TO BEEKMAN DOWNSTATE INA PRIVATE AMBULANCE - AFTER COMING HOME FROM BEEKMAN DOWNSTATE. I never went back to work because the work was TO STRANGE - I retired after 27 years But then I STARTED to work for Mark Aug 3rd 1986 for 3 DAYS a week. Man - we DON'T FOL - I AM STILL WORKING for MARK - We then took a TRIP TO ISRAEL IN NOVEMBER 1985 - WE VISITED MY WIFE'S Relatives - WE STAYD AT THE PLAZA MOTEL IN TEL-AVIV where we went to my sons friends WEDDING. We STAYED IN TEL AVIV FOR 5 DAYS. THEN - We went to THE KING DAVID IN JURUSOLUM - where my son JEFF HIRED a LIMO TO TAKE us AROUND WE STAYED IN J. FOR ABOUT 4 DAYS ARRIVING BACK HOME on my BIRTHDAY DEC. 4, 1985
